Scope: roads, the Pond A storm-water outfall, storm, sewerage, potable water and fire-fighting, TSE irrigation, road lighting, telecom and CCTV networks in three zones of Tabuk Industrial City. Contract value 140.5M SAR excl. VAT.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. The project is at 50.7% against 35.2% planned under the revised plan, 15.5% ahead (SPI 1.44), after gaining 0.8% this week against 0.6% planned.

Well ahead of the revised plan, but the forecast finish is 34 days after the contract date. The weekly report and the P6 update (data date 19-Oct-2026) both forecast project handover on 07-Oct-2027, 34 days after the contract completion date of 03-Sep-2027. The P6 project finish has −29.3 days of float, and 220 open activities have negative float, mostly in electrical (82), CCTV (61) and telecom (43) works. Against the original baseline, which called for 64.2% by the end of October, the project is behind.

The weekly report and P6 disagree on the zone completion dates. The weekly report forecasts Zones 1, 2 and 3 to finish between 30-Aug-2027 and 04-Oct-2027, while the P6 update finishes them between 05-Jun-2027 and 24-Jul-2027 with positive float. Both agree on project handover, 07-Oct-2027. The late items in P6 are road works, electrical, CCTV and telecom.

Data notes

  • Physical progress appears with two values. The weekly report's summary and Progress sheet give 50.69% (179,604 of 354,339 budgeted man-hours), while the Physical-Chart Data sheet and the P6 progress certificate give 48.03% (of 373,967). The headline uses the report's own summary figure.
  • The MODON weekly summary file reports 47.98% actual against 37.66% planned (previous week 47.57%). These are cost-based earned-value figures, not physical progress.
  • The project ID differs between files: TAB1-02-003 in the weekly report, TAB1-01-009 in the MODON summary file and the older procurement sheet, and TAB1-02-005 to TAB1-02-008 in the risk register.
  • Report week: the Milestones sheet states contract week 59 of 108, and the consultant's audits label 17-Oct-2026 as Week-59. Counting whole weeks from site handover gives 58. The report uses the stated week 59.
  • Zone milestones disagree three ways: the weekly report's baseline (Zone 1 09-Feb-2027), the P6 baseline in the progress tracker (Zone 1 05-Jun-2027), and the forecasts in the weekly report and P6; see Milestones. The "Complete mobilization" milestone has a baseline of 10-Aug-2027, which looks wrong.
  • The P6 project finish of 07-Oct-2027 is 34 calendar days after the contract date, but its total float is −29.3 days.
  • The invoice log lists 14 invoices totalling 46,212,660 SAR, while its summary says 13 submitted and 14 approved by the CM.
  • The "Resources at site" panel (28/32 non-manual, 57/192 manual) shows the September figures, not October's (28/35 and 69/162). Cumulative actual equipment has stayed at 269 since March 2026.
  • The summary panel shows 6,360 safe man-hours this week, while the HSE statistics sheet shows 9,660.
  • The workbook has two procurement sheets. "Procurement (2)" is an older version with lower rates (for example ABC 32% against 50%); the report uses "Procurement". Some items have no quantity or delivery rate.
  • All 14 risk register entries are marked "Open", although 10 of them have their treatment closed.
  • Scope quantities have no zone split and no previous-week values, so the this-week column is empty. Only two photos in the report are large enough to use; the other two are 382 and 546 px wide.
